title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Also Streams on Hulu in U.S. on October 11
content:
The series will begin airing on the Fuji TV channel and its affiliates on October 11 at 11:15 p.m. JST (10:15 a.m. EDT), taking over the timeslot of the One Piece anime, which aired its last episode for this year on September 27. The series will also stream on Amazon Prime Video and U-NEXT streaming services in Japan 30 minutes after its broadcast at 12:15 a.m. JST.

Crunchyroll will simultaneously stream the anime in Japanese with English subtitles on October 11 in the United States, Canada, Latin America including Brazil, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, India, Southeast Asia, and Europe.

Netflix will also stream the series in the U.S. on October 17, and Netflix is listing the series to start streaming on October 14 in selected areas/countries.

The first episode also screened in advance at the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Special Panel at New York Comic Con on Thursday.

The staff for the new anime includes:

• Composition and Direction Arrangement: Matsuto Seya

• Animation Character Design & General Animation Director: Tadayoshi Yamamuro

• Editing: Eiichi Nishimura

• Compositing Director: Yōsuke Motoki

• Music: Norihito Sumitomo

The anime will again feature Kōichi Yamadera as Beerus.

MEGATERA･ZERO performs the opening theme song "ONOGAMI," and VK Blanka performs the ending theme song "Kan Peki No Peki."

Akio Iyoku stated the work started a few years ago and is an "enhanced" edition of the Dragon Ball Super anime that features a reconstruction of the story, and includes new and redrawn cuts.

The official announcement of the anime stated:

The project features extensive new cuts, revisions to existing scenes, a complete re-rendering of all footage, newly recorded dubbing with added score and sound effects, and a full reconstruction of the story. Living up to the name ENHANCED, this edition employs the latest visual expression to deliver greater power and immersion across all scenes, especially the battle sequences. The result is an ENHANCED edition that expresses Akira Toriyama 's original idea and worldbuilding more accurately, that will be broadcasted with highly satisfying quality.

The anime staff stated, "the anime Dragon Ball Super ... is set to begin anew as Dragon Ball Super: Beerus in Fall 2026."

The staff describes the story:

Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an Earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his allies—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

Dragon Ball Super premiered in July 2015 and aired for 131 episodes until March 2018. Funimation and Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and Funimation released the series on home video. Funimation debuted the English dub to its streaming service in December 2016. The English dub premiered on Adult Swim 's Toonami block in January 2017.

title: Blazblue: CentralFiction Fighting Game Gets Release on PS5
content:
Arc System Works Europe revealed on Saturday that its Blazblue: CentralFiction fighting game will get a release on the PlayStation 5. The PS5 version will include rollback netcode, cross-play with PC, four new text languages (French, Italian, German, and Spanish), and new features in Training Mode.

Arc System Works had teased a new DLC character for the game during the EVO 2026 event in June, and revealed a few days later the new character is Trinity Glassfille. The character will be the first new character to join the game since the character Jubei debuted in 2017.

Trinity Glassfille will be available only on the PlayStation 4 and PC versions of the game. The announcement in June did not mention the new character's availability for the arcade, PlayStation 3, or Switch versions of the game.

Arc System Works America added on Saturday the PS5 version release is scheduled for after the "TRINITY -PHASE 3-" update.

Blazblue: CentralFiction originally debuted in Japanese arcades in November 2015, and the game launched in Japan for the PS4 and PS3 in October 2016. Aksys Games released the game in North America in November 2016. The Switch version shipped in February 2019.

BlazBlue Entropy Effect , a side-scrolling roguelite game, launched with its early access version on Steam in August 2023. The full release launched in January 2024 for PC via Steam . The game's BlazBlue Entropy Effect X version launched for the PlayStation 5, Switch, and Xbox Series X|S on February 12.

title: Japanese Studio Creative Freaks to Lead Production on Sentinel 6 Anime Executive Produced by NBA, NFL Players Michael Carter-Williams, Jamaal Williams
content:
The Hollywood Reporter entertainment news website reported on Saturday that former NBA player Michael Carter-Williams and NFL player Jamaal Williams will executive produce Sentinel 6 , an "Afro-futurist sci-fi adventure anime." The outlet stated Creative Freaks , a Kyoto-based background art studio, is "leading the production" on the work.

Creative Freaks has not previously been credited for animation production on a work, but has worked on background art for such anime as Spy×Family , Synduality: Noir , Ya Boy Kongming! , Chainsaw Man , several series in the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba anime, Kaiju No. 8 TV 2 , and Dragon Ball Daima , among many other works.

The studio was founded in 2014 and its website states in 2023 it launched its own animation production division. The company also has studios in Tokyo (where the animation division is located), Vietnam, Thailand, and Indonesia.

Jamacian-American writer Pat Stout and the late Asa Palmer created the franchise in 2019 through their production company Sable Kudzu Entertainment LLC.

Sable Kudzu Entertainment LLC launched a Kickstarter campaign for a trailer for the project in December 2021, which reached US$18,706 of its US$15,000 goal by January 2022. The company posted the trailer in December 2022. Bulgaria- and Germany-based Chase A Cloud Studio animated the trailer.

The Kickstarter campaign describes the story:

Sentinel 6 is an Afro-Futuristic anime about a post war Earth, following the invasion of intergalactic terrorists. As fate would have it; Earth was destined to be the battleground of God's scorn. The Great Phoenix War resulted in the near total destruction of Earth, wiping out the entire Zeronian Race except for one powerful child. 429 years later, the Earth has rebuilt itself up and is being threatened by that same child, Krath Mudaak. In a desperate cry for help, the Earth's spiritual energy splits and imbues itself into 6 beacons of power across the world, the Sentinel 6! With the power of the Sentinel's Mind, Heart, Hands, Feet, Sword and Shield; the six warriors are destined to protect Earth during this dire time. Saint Dubois, a stellar student-athlete, is days away from achieving his dream; attending the most prestigious Blik program and following in the footsteps of his favorite athlete. However, a last-minute recruitment by Ranē Bogle, combined with family woes, puts a wrench in his plan. Now, instead of being a starter at his dream school, he must battle with the talented and intimidating Ali Washington for Lead Stryker. Tensions continue to build off the field as the two discover more about the other. As they travel the world with Ranē playing Blik, they meet Kalani Walker, Chafalumisa and Zhu Sianing. With the guidance of Sankofa, an Earth resident for over 600 years, the six heroes understand their destiny to protect the planet. Realizing that Krath Mudaak is the root of all evils, the six must put their differences aside, come together and defeat him to fulfill their destiny. Failure means the destruction of Earth and ultimately the galaxy!

The series is planned to have 11 or 12 30-minute episodes. LeSean Thomas ( Yasuke , The Boondocks, Bass x Machina ) wrote the pilot and is serving as a consulting producer on the project.

Talent manager Sam Goff is also an executive producer.

Palmer died in 2025, and later that year Carter-Williams and Williams fully funded the pilot for the show.

The Hollywood Reporter stated the project was "taken out to two dozen animation production studios" this year, with Creative Freaks winning the bid.

The series is planned for an English-language version first. Current cast members include influencer King Vader (Dominique Barrett), Jamaal Williams, and dub actor Cedric Williams . Bang Zoom! will lead the reverse localization into Japanese.

title: New 'Naruto' Manga 'Shadow Rising' Announced
content:
The Naruto: What's Next? panel at New York Comic Con 2026 announced on Saturday that Masashi Kishimoto will launch a new Naruto manga titled Naruto: Shadow Rising , revealing a super teaser announcement video.

The new series is part of Project Rasengan , a three-year timeline of upcoming releases within the Naruto franchise. Currently announced projects include a crossover anime series , a mobile game, and a card game. More information on the new manga will be revealed at Jump Festa 2027.

Kishimoto serialized Naruto in Weekly Shounen Jump from September 1999 to November 2014. Shueisha published the 72th and final volume in February 2015. The manga has a cumulative 250 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

Boruto: Naruto Next Generations , the sequel manga written by Ukyou Kodachi with illustrations by Mikio Ikemoto , began serializing in Weekly Shounen Jump in May 2016, with Kishimoto serving as the supervisor. The manga transferred to V-Jump in 2019 before Kishimoto took over the story in November 2020. The first part concluded in April 2023, with Shueisha publishing the 20th volume in June 2023.

The second part of the manga, Boruto: Two Blue Vortex , launched in August 2023, with Kishimoto and Ikemoto serving as writer and illustrator, respectively. Shueisha released the ninth volume on October 2.

The original Naruto television anime aired in 220 episodes from October 2002 to February 2007. The Naruto Shippuden sequel ran for 500 episodes from February 2007 to March 2017.

The sequel manga was adapted into a 293-episode television anime that aired between April 2017 and March 2023. The Boruto: Naruto Next Generations Part 2 sequel anime is currently in production.

VIZ Media licensed the original manga in English in November 2002 and released the 72th volume in February 2015. The company licenced the Boruto: Naruto Next Generations manga sequel in September 2016. The second part's sixth volume went on sale on October 2, with the seventh volume planned for a March 2, 2027 release.

Super Teaser

title: 'Naruto x Ninkuu' Crossover Anime Announced
content:
The "Naruto: What's Next?" panel at New York Comic Con 2026 announced a brand new four-episode crossover anime based on Masashi Kishimoto 's Naruto manga and Kouji Kiriyama 's Ninkuu manga on Saturday. The Naruto franchise's official website opened a new page, revealing the main cast, staff, theme songs, a teaser visual (pictured above), and teaser promotional video.

Cast Naruto Uzumaki: Junko Takeuchi ( Hunter x Hunter ) Fuusuke: Rica Matsumoto ( Pokemon ) Sasuke Uchiha: Noriaki Sugiyama ( Fate/stay night ) Aicho: Mitsuaki Madono ( Bleach ) Sakura Haruno: Chie Nakamura ( Dororo ) Touji: Juurouta Kosugi ( JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken ) Kakashi Hatake: Kazuhiko Inoue ( Natsume Yuujinchou ) Rihoko: Megumi Hayashibara ( Shinseiki Evangelion ) Hiroyuki: Katsumi Suzuki ( InuYasha )

Staff Director: Noriyuki Abe ( Bleach ) Character Design: Tetsuya Nishio ( Naruto ) Original Concept Cooperation: Shou Hinata ( One Piece Novel: A light novel) Series Composition: Masaya Honda ( Shin Ikkitousen ) Assistant Director: Nozomi Fukui ( Boruto: Naruto Next Generations ) Art Director: Mio Isshiki ( Cool Doji Danshi ) Director of Photography: Kazuhiro Yamada ( Steel Ball Run: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken ) Art Design: Yuuji Ikeda ( Killing Bites ) CG Director: Yutaka Nakajima ( Gintama' ) Color Design: Tomoe Imamura ([i]Boruto: Naruto Next Generations[/i) CG Asset Director: Kazufumi Gotou ( Bleach: Sennen Kessen-hen CG director) Music: Yasuharu Takanashi ( Fairy Tail ), -yaiba- ( Naruto: Shippuuden ), Yusuke Honma ( Great Teacher Onizuka ) Editing: Yumika Okazaki ( Tougen Anki ), Seiji Morita ( Boruto: Naruto Next Generations ) Sound Director: Yasushi Nagura ( Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou ) Studio: Studio Pierrot

Rock band FLOW ( Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch ) is performing the opening theme "GO!!! (20th Anniversary ver.)" and ending theme "Viva★Rock."

The anime project is the long-delayed work originally planned to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the Naruto television anime. It had been scheduled to air for four consecutive weeks beginning in September 2023, but was postponed in August 2023 to improve production quality.

Kiriyama serialized Ninkuu in Weekly Shounen Jump from June 1993 to August 1995. The sequel, Ninkuu: Second Stage - Etonin-hen , ran in Ultra Jump from September 2025 to September 2011.

Studio Pierrot adapted the original manga into a television anime that aired in 55 episodes from January 1995 to February 1996.

Kishimoto serialized Naruto in Weekly Shounen Jump from September 1999 to November 2014. Shueisha published the 72th and final volume in February 2015. VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in November 2002 and released the 72th volume in October 2015.

Boruto: Naruto Next Generations , the sequel manga written by Ukyou Kodachi with illustrations by Mikio Ikemoto began in Weekly Shounen Jump in May 2016, with Kishimoto serving as the supervisor. The manga transferred to V-Jump in 2019. Kishimoto took over the story in November 2020, concluding it in April 2023 after 20 volumes.

Kishimoto resumed the manga under the title Boruto: Two Blue Vortex in August that year, with Ikemoto remaining as the illustrator. Shueisha published the ninth volume on October 2.

The original Naruto television anime that aired in 220 episodes from October 2002 to February 2007. The Naruto Shippuden sequel ran for 500 episodes from February 2007 to March 2017.

The Naruto franchise has received 11 anime movies, with the latest, Boruto: Naruto the Movie , premiering in August 2015.

title: One-Punch Man Season 3 Anime's 2nd Part Reveals January 2027 Debut in Video
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed in a new trailer on Sunday that the second cours (quarter of a year) of the third anime season based on ONE and Yūsuke Murata 's One Punch Man manga will debut in January 2027.

Viz Media is streaming an English-subtitled version of the trailer.

Both videos reveal that JAM Project is returning to perform the opening theme song titled "Never Done - SUPREME POWER VS ULTIMATE FEAR -."

The anime's website also revealed a new key visual.

The third season premiered with a recap on October 5, 2025. The overall 25th episode of the anime, the first episode in the third season, aired a week later. The anime is streaming on Hulu in the U.S., Disney+ in Canada, and Netflix in Latin America, Australia, and New Zealand. In Latin America and Oceania, Crunchyroll is also streaming the anime.

J.C. Staff is returning from the second season to animate the series. Madhouse animated the first season.

Shinpei Nagai ( Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san , DOGEZA: I Tried Asking While Kowtowing. ) is directing the anime at J.C. Staff . Tomohiro Suzuki returns from previous seasons to oversee the series scripts. Chikashi Kubota also returns from previous seasons as character designer, but this time alongside Shinjiro Kuroda and Ryōsuke Shirakawa . Sakura Murakami is now the art director (Murakami previously worked on background art for the second season, with Shigemi Ikeda and Yukiko Maruyama previously credited as art directors for the second season). Mayumi Tanahashi returns as color designer from the second season. Yuki Hirose is now the director of photography (replacing Yoshio Ōkouchi from the previous season). Masahiro Gotō , Yoshikazu Iwanami , and Makoto Miyazaki all return from the second season as editor, sound director, and music composer, respectively.

JAM Project with metal group BABYMETAL performed the opening theme song "Get No Satisfied!," and Makoto Furukawa performed the ending theme song "Soko ni Aru Akari" ("The Light, That's There") for the first cours .

The first anime season aired in Japan from October to December 2015.

The second season began with a television special in April 2019, then the first episode premiered one week later.

Mayumi Tanahashi returns as color designer from the second season. Yuki Hirose is now the director of photography (replacing Yoshio Ōkouchi from the previous season). Masahiro Gotō , Yoshikazu Iwanami , and Makoto Miyazaki all return from the second season as editor, sound director, and music composer, respectively.

JAM Project with metal group BABYMETAL performed the opening theme song "Get No Satisfied!," and Makoto Furukawa performed the ending theme song "Soko ni Aru Akari" ("The Light, That's There") for the first cours .
The first anime season aired in Japan from October to December 2015.
The second season began with a television special in April 2019, then the first episode premiered one week later.

title: Fall 2026 Has Two Anime That Turn Solo Leveling’s Power Fantasy Into Comedy
content:
It is already the second week of Fall 2026, and yet the season is still blooming, with many new anime yet to be released, proving that there is still plenty to look forward to. The Fall season is indeed a fruitful one for anime, featuring a variety of series, including returning anime with new seasons and several newcomers making their debut. However, ever since Solo Leveling debuted in 2024, bringing a power system rooted in a Korean webtoon to the forefront, there has been at least one new anime that draws comparisons to its narrative pattern, and 2026 has been particularly keen on featuring such series.

It started with Tomb Raider King in the Summer season earlier this year, and now the Fall season has Overgeared , another anime being compared to Solo Leveling for similar reasons: its depiction of a self-leveling journey based on a Korean webtoon, or manhwa. However, Overgeared brings its own nuance to the formula, offering an amusing take on the Solo Leveling trope that blends naturally with the series. Now, earlier this week, on October 6, The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life debuted, taking the power system trope seen in anime such as Solo Leveling even further.

Two Fall 2026 Anime Put a Hilarious Twist on Solo Leveling ’s Main Trope

Anime such as Solo Leveling , which follow a protagonist’s journey of leveling up and gaining unparalleled power, tend to take a more serious approach. Sung Jinwoo’s journey has maintained a serious tone from the start as he goes from zero to hero, never showing an ounce of unseriousness along the way. As he reaches a level where he is stronger than everyone else, the story eventually becomes about aura farming, with him dominating almost every scene he enters. This is precisely why the two currently airing anime stand out as hilarious alternatives, taking an amusing turn on the familiar trope.

Overgeared , with its protagonist , showcases someone desperate to succeed in life and willing to do anything to achieve it. Grid frequently finds himself begging for his life, much like a hilarious side character in any power-leveling series. Across its two episodes, Grid begins his leveling-up adventure, only to lose some of his levels and even reach a negative level. However, his desperation for success becomes a source of comedy as he continues to work hard and demonstrate determination, all while never hiding his weak, vulnerable side or being afraid to ask for help, making him feel more relatable. Meanwhile, The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life takes a more direct parody approach to the power system trope.

It features Rein, an enchanter who strengthens his guildmates’ equipment but gets kicked out after they realize their weapons cannot be upgraded any further because they have reached their maximum potential. After being expelled, Rein takes the mana from all the other equipment and hilariously transfers it into a copper sword, turning it into a cheat weapon capable of destroying anything in its path. However, instead of embarking on a revenge journey and taking himself too seriously, Rein begins a carefree, laid-back adventure. It is a hilarious take on the power system that few would expect from an overpowered protagonist, making the anime feel refreshing among the many series compared to Solo Leveling every season.

With two Fall anime taking a different approach instead of simply depicting Solo Leveling ‘s power fantasy, fans can enjoy the familiar appeal of watching an overpowered protagonist while getting a refreshing and amusing experience that feels entirely new.

title: Naruto Mobile Game to Get Worldwide Release; Naruto Card Game Reveals Demo, Release Dates
content:
The "NARUTO: What's Next?" panel at New York Comic Con announced on Saturday that the Naruto Mobile game, currently only available in Mainland China, will get a worldwide release. More details will be revealed at the Jump Festa '27 event, which will take place on December 19-20.

The original game launched in Mainland China in 2016.

Additionally, the event revealed more details about Naruto Card Game , a new trading card game in the franchise.

Studio Pierrot produced a trailer for the upcoming trading card game, which was played during the panel.

Select trading card game stores will host demos for the game from February 5-19 and February 19 through March 5, before a wider demo event at more stores on March 5-31.

The game will officially launch in June 2027. The game will have three starter decks centered around Naruto, Sasuke, and Gaara.

Bandai previously released the Naruto Collectible Card Game in 2006 until 2013.

Both projects are part of an overall " Project Rasengan " announced at the panel. "Project Rasengan" is a project that will "chart the future of Naruto and Boruto as it expands long term" through anime, manga, games and other media.

title: Naruto to Officially Return With Brand-New Manga From Original Creator – Watch First Look Trailer
content:
Naruto ‘s creator is officially returning to the series with a brand new manga, and the first look has been revealed at what to expect. Naruto has kicked off a new wave of projects that are being lined up for the next three years at least. Taking the stage during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend , the franchise detailed a lot of the new projects now in the works during a special panel. But there’s one big surprise that fans certainly never expected to see happen. Kishimoto’s going back to the story for more.

It has been officially announced that Masashi Kishimoto is now working on a brand new Naruto manga series. Dubbed “Shadow Rising,” this new Naruto series teases that it will explore a piece of the canon that had only been hinted at before. Because while Boruto: Naruto Next Generations is an official sequel set even further in the timeline , this new series teases what happens before Naruto is officially crowned as the Seventh Hokage. Check out the first look teaser trailer below.

New Naruto Shadow Rising Manga Announced

Naruto Shadow Rising (which has yet to be confirmed as the official name of the series) revealed its first look teaser trailer at the very end of the New York Comic Con 2026 panel, and it was there that it was confirmed that fans will be getting much more infromation about the new series during Jump Festa 2027 later this December . But while very little concrete information has been revealed about the series thus far, it’s plenty exciting already as Kishimoto is making a proper return to the franchise. Especially since he’s been around it for so long.

Kishimoto returned to Naruto for a special one-shot story for Minato Namikaze as part of the franchise’s 20th anniversary some time ago, and has been helping out with the story for the Boruto: Naruto Next Generations sequel series. But with this interquel, the creator is going back in full to the franchise. It does raise a lot of questions about whether or not it will overshadow the ongoing sequel manga series ( which is now celebrating its own 10th anniversary ), but there are still many questions such as how long this new series will ultimately run for.

Naruto Confirms Return With New Shonen Jump Anime Crossover

This isn’t all that is in the works for the Naruto franchise, however, as there’s a new revival anime now in production. First revealed to be in the works back in 2023 before its indefinite delay, it was confirmed during the New York Comic Con 2026 panel that this revival is actually going to be a crossover with a surprise Shonen Jump classic franchise, Koji Kiriyama’s Ninku . A series that hasn’t had an anime in 30 years, and is making a proper return with this new four episode special crossover.

A release date or window has yet to be announced for Naruto x Ninku as of the time of this announcement, but the trailer above teases the classic Team 7 line up ending up in a whole new universe. Naruto has planned out new projects through to at least 2029 ( including a new live-action movie now in the works ), so we’ll see much more of it all soon enough. What are you hoping to see in Naruto ‘s official manga return? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Masashi Kishimoto to Launch New Naruto Manga
content:
The "NARUTO: What's Next?" panel at New York Comic Con announced on Saturday that Masashi Kishimoto will launch a new manga in his Naruto franchise. The below video teases a possible title: Shadow Rising Naruto (or Naruto Shadow Rising ). More details will be revealed at the Jump Festa '27 event, which will take place on December 19-20.

Kishimoto launched the Naruto ninja manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 1999, and ended the series in November 2014. The manga has spawned the Naruto and Naruto Shippūden television anime series, original video anime ( OVA ) projects, several anime films, spinoff manga, the Boruto sequel manga and anime series, a series of novels, stage plays, and video games.

Manga storywriter Ukyō Kodachi and Mikio Ikemoto launched the Boruto sequel manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in May 2016, and the manga ran monthly in the magazine. The manga transferred to V Jump in July 2019. Kishimoto replaced Kodachi as the manga's storywriter in November 2020, starting with the manga's 52nd chapter.

The manga went on hiatus in April 2023 and returned with the title Boruto: Two Blue Vortex in August 2023. The series is ongoing.
